label: Plain
tagline: Find a time that works for everyone.
botPollCreated: A new poll is open for **{title}**. Run `/schedule` or open it here: {url}
botVoteBody: Availability is closed. Vote for a time below. Times appear in your own timezone.
botVoteClosed: Voting has ended for this poll.
botPollClosed: The poll is closed. The vote will appear in this channel shortly.
botPollDecreed: The event is confirmed. Watch this channel for the announcement.
botPollCancelled: This poll was cancelled. The {organizer} may start a new one.
botNeedManage: You need the Manage Channels or Manage Server permission to link a group to this channel.
notMember: You are not in this group yet. In Discord, run /schedule in the group's channel to join, then reload this page.
notLinked: This group is not linked to a Discord channel, so votes and announcements will not be posted there. In the channel, run `/chronomancer setup` and paste this into its `code` option:
botSessionCancelled: The event planned for {when} is cancelled.
botRemindersNoFit: No reminder fits before the event, because it is sooner than your reminder times. Change them with `/chronomancer setup`.
botRecurredBody: **{title}** is scheduled for {when}, the same time as before.
botRecurrenceNote: When it ends, the next one is scheduled automatically for {when}.
events: Create a Discord event for each session
gridHint: Click (or tap) a box once for available, twice for maybe, three times for not available. One more click clears it. Click a day or a time to fill a whole column or row.
